title: A New Catalogue and Insights into the 2022 Adriatic Offshore Seismic Sequence Using a Machine Learning-Based Procedure.
summary: A machine-learning phase-picking/association procedure produced a 2,780-event catalogue and new analyses of the 2022 Adriatic offshore seismic sequence. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
